paragraphs: He is mentioned at the beginning of Bereshit Rabbah, chapter 5; R' Berechiah reports in his name.[^1]

notes.text: רפ״ה is read as beginning of chapter5 (ראש פרק ה), not a single numeral285 or chapter85. That is conventional decoding, without a verified named edition. Berechiah reports in the heading subject's name, not the reverse; both abbreviated personal titles remain R'. Earlier285/85 readings remain archived as historical interpretations, not verified locators.
